untuned_acceptance_sample.q: 一个端口最多有多少虚拟通道？
untuned_acceptance_sample.e: PCI Express Ports can support 1 to 8 Virtual Channels

untuned_acceptance_sample.q: 只复位一个功能会把链路也复位吗？
untuned_acceptance_sample.e: The Link state must not be affected by an FLR

untuned_acceptance_sample.q: Flit 的有效性判断中，FEC correction 和 CRC check 的顺序是怎样的？
untuned_acceptance_sample.e: CRC check passes after performing FEC correction

untuned_acceptance_sample.q: VC ID 0 可以分配给非默认 VC 吗？
untuned_acceptance_sample.e: VC ID 0 is assigned and fixed to the default VC

untuned_acceptance_sample.q: Where is ECRC generated, and who checks it at the end of the path?
untuned_acceptance_sample.e: The ECRC is generated by the Transaction Layer in the source component

untuned_acceptance_sample.q: Is a transmitter required to support data poisoning?
untuned_acceptance_sample.e: Support for TLP poisoning in a Transmitter is optional
